query: SELECT lc.periodoCustoId, c.nome AS conta, SUM(CAST(lc.valor AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS totalValor FROM lancamento_custo lc JOIN conta_custo c ON lc.contaCustoId = c.id WHERE lc.periodoCustoId IN (1, 30001, 30002) GROUP BY lc.periodoCustoId, c.nome ORDER BY lc.periodoCustoId, totalValor DESC;
